달.forms: 달이 · 달을 · 이번 달 · 다음 달 · 한 달
달.x: I'm going to Korea next month.
달.e: Moon and month — like English 'moon' and 'month'. 이번 달 = this month.
달.t: Count months as native + 달 (한 달, 두 달) or Sino-Korean + 개월 (일 개월).

휴대폰.x: I left my phone at home.
휴대폰.t: 핸드폰 and 휴대폰 are both everyday words for a mobile phone; 폰 alone is casual.

배우다.e: Opposite of 가르치다 (teach). The noun 배우 (actor) is an unrelated word.

낙엽.x: There are lots of fallen leaves on the street.

경쟁.ex: 이 분야는 회사들 사이의 경쟁이 아주 심해요.
경쟁.x: Competition between companies in this field is really fierce.
경쟁.t: Common pattern: 경쟁이 심하다, 'competition is fierce.'

분실물.ex: 지하철에서 잃어버린 가방을 분실물 센터에서 찾았어요.
분실물.x: I found the bag I lost on the subway at the lost-and-found center.
분실물.t: 분실물 센터 is the lost-and-found office, found in subway stations and airports.

동창.x: I have a high school reunion this weekend.
동창.e: Literally 'same window' — studying under the same school window.

영향.x: Parents have a big influence on their children.
영향.e: Literally 'shadow and echo': what follows something wherever it goes.
영향.t: 영향을 주다 or 영향을 미치다 means 'to influence'; 영향을 받다 means 'to be influenced'.

승객.ex: 버스에 승객이 너무 많아서 앉을 수 없었어요.
승객.x: There were so many passengers on the bus that I couldn't sit down.

그리워하다.x: My grandmother always misses her hometown.
그리워하다.e: From 그립다 'missed' plus -어하다, which turns a feeling into an action verb.
그리워하다.t: Use 그리워하다 for other people's feelings with an object (N을); for your own, say 고향이 그리워요.

함부로.ex: 남의 물건을 함부로 만지면 안 돼요.
함부로.x: You shouldn't touch other people's things without asking.

템플스테이.ex: 이번 휴가에는 절에서 템플스테이를 해 보고 싶어요.
템플스테이.x: This vacation I'd like to try a temple stay at a Buddhist temple.
템플스테이.e: From English 'temple' + 'stay'; the name was created for a Korean program that opened temples to visitors in 2002.
템플스테이.t: Guests usually wear temple clothes, join the dawn chanting, eat a silent temple meal (발우공양) and try meditation; many temples run programs in English.

보험금.x: I received an insurance payout after a car accident.
보험금.e: Literally 'insurance money' — -금 = a sum of money: 보험금, 지원금, 장학금.
보험금.t: Easy to mix up: you pay 보험료 and you receive 보험금.

연구자.ex: 많은 연구자들이 이 문제를 해결하려고 노력하고 있어요.
연구자.x: Many researchers are trying to solve this problem.
연구자.e: -자 = person who does it: 연구자, 학습자, 교육자.

공인 중개사.ex: 공인 중개사가 계약서 내용을 자세히 설명해 줬어요.
공인 중개사.x: The realtor explained the contract in detail.

다듬다.m: to trim, to tidy; to polish, to refine; to clean (vegetables)
다듬다.ex: 보고서를 내기 전에 문장을 다시 다듬었어요.
다듬다.x: I polished the sentences again before turning in the report.
다듬다.t: In cooking, 파를 다듬다 means cleaning and trimming green onions.

찌르다.forms: 찔러요 · 찔렀어요 · 찌를 거예요 · 찌르세요 (르 irregular)
찌르다.m: to stab, prick, poke; to sting (a smell)
찌르다.x: My friend poked me in the side with a finger.
찌르다.t: 양심에 찔리다 means 'to feel a pang of conscience'.

거주지.x: If your place of residence changes, you have to report it to the community center.
거주지.e: Literally 'residing place'. -지 = place: 거주지, 관광지, 목적지.

영장.x: The police obtained an arrest warrant from the court.

충당하다.m: to cover (costs), to meet, to fund
충당하다.x: He covered his tuition with part-time work.

경박하다.ex: 장례식장에서 그렇게 경박하게 웃으면 안 돼요.
경박하다.x: You shouldn't laugh so flippantly at a funeral.
경박하다.e: Literally 'light and thin' — lacking weight or depth.
경박하다.t: Pronounced [경바카다]; the native equivalent is 가볍다, as in 입이 가볍다 'loose-lipped'.

무수히.x: Countless stars are shining in the night sky.
무수히.e: Literally 'without number': too many to count.

가재는 게 편.forms: 가재는 게 편이라더니 · 가재는 게 편이에요
가재는 게 편.m: birds of a feather stick together; people side with their own kind
가재는 게 편.ex: 가재는 게 편이라고, 선생님들끼리 서로 감싸 줬어요.
가재는 게 편.x: Birds of a feather stick together; the teachers covered for each other.
가재는 게 편.e: Literally 'the crayfish takes the crab's side' — look-alike creatures stick together.

궤도에 오르다.forms: 궤도에 올라요 · 올랐어요 · 오를 거예요 (르 irregular); often 사업이 궤도에 오르다
궤도에 오르다.m: to get on track, to get into full swing, to become established
궤도에 오르다.x: It took three years for the shop to get on track.
궤도에 오르다.e: Literally 'to climb onto the track or orbit' — running smoothly on its set path.
rel: to settle in, to become established

정학.ex: 그 학생은 폭력 사건으로 정학을 당했어요.
정학.x: That student was suspended over a violent incident.
정학.t: Don't confuse it with 휴학: 정학 is a punishment, while 휴학 is a leave you choose.

집권당.ex: 집권당이 이번 선거에서 과반 의석을 잃었습니다.
집권당.x: The ruling party lost its majority of seats in this election.
집권당.t: In everyday news 여당 is the more common word for the ruling party.

국정감사.m: parliamentary audit of the government (annual inspection)
국정감사.x: Every fall, the National Assembly carries out its audit of the government.
국정감사.t: News usually shortens it to 국감.

사회공포증.ex: 사회공포증이 있으면 사람들 앞에서 말하기가 힘들어요.
사회공포증.x: With social anxiety, it's hard to speak in front of people.

병리학.ex: 그녀는 의대에서 병리학을 전공하고 대학 병원에서 일해요.
병리학.x: She majored in pathology in medical school and works at a university hospital.
병리학.e: -학 = field of study: 병리학, 역학, 심리학.

소염제.ex: 의사가 무릎 통증 때문에 소염제를 처방해 줬어요.
소염제.x: The doctor prescribed an anti-inflammatory for my knee pain.
소염제.e: Literally 'drug that puts out inflammation'; -제 = medicine/agent: 진통제, 수면제.
소염제.t: Often paired as 소염진통제, a drug that both reduces inflammation and relieves pain.

주사제.x: I was treated with an injection instead of pills.
주사제.e: Literally 'drug that is poured and shot in'.

저장장치.ex: 중요한 파일은 외부 저장장치에도 꼭 백업하세요.
저장장치.x: Be sure to back up important files to an external storage device too.
저장장치.t: 저장하다 is also the everyday word for saving a file: 파일을 저장하세요.

독자반응.ex: 독자반응 비평은 독자가 작품의 의미를 만든다고 봅니다.
독자반응.x: Reader-response criticism holds that readers create a work's meaning.
독자반응.e: Literally 'reader's response'; -자 = person who does it: 독자, 저자, 작자.
독자반응.t: Usually seen in the phrase 독자반응 비평 'reader-response criticism'; pronounced [독짜바능].

파리협정.ex: 파리협정은 지구 평균 기온 상승을 2도보다 훨씬 낮게, 가능하면 1.5도 이내로 제한하는 것을 목표로 합니다.
파리협정.x: The Paris Agreement aims to keep global warming well below 2 degrees, ideally within 1.5 degrees.
파리협정.t: Pronounced [파리협쩡]: ㅈ after ㅂ becomes tense.

영롱하다.ex: 아침 햇살에 풀잎의 이슬이 영롱하게 빛났어요.
영롱하다.x: The dew on the grass sparkled brilliantly in the morning sun.
영롱하다.e: Both syllables picture tinkling, glittering jade.
영롱하다.t: Pronounced [영농하다] — ㄹ becomes ㄴ after ㅇ.

욕속부달.m: haste makes waste, more haste, less speed
욕속부달.x: Haste makes waste, as they say, so let's do it slowly and carefully.
욕속부달.t: Often followed by 이라고 하다 to quote it like a proverb, similar to 급할수록 돌아가라.

변호권.m: right to counsel, right of defense
변호권.ex: 모든 피고인의 변호권은 헌법에 의해 보장됩니다.
변호권.x: A defendant's right to counsel is guaranteed by the constitution.
